aggregation_pass_rule: all required roles are captured, deterministic links are resolved, and project-reviewer has top-level RESULT: PASS

roles.prompt_template: Explore the scoped harness request, gather facts, do not edit files, and report RESULT: PASS if no blocking issue is found.
Implement only if a real blocking issue is found; otherwise provide a no-op implementation confirmation.
Review the explored/implemented workflow, put non-blocking issues under Non-Blocking Warnings, and gate with top-level RESULT: PASS only when strict acceptance is ready.
